title: SCLA-Net: Structure-aware Context and Localization Aggregation Network for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
description:
Official implementation of SCLA-Net, a lightweight 3D medical image segmentation network combining a depthwise-separable encoder-decoder backbone with (i) Structural Context Enhanced Attention (SCEA), which extracts complementary structural context along three orthogonal anatomical directions, (ii) a Structure-aware Localization Token Generator (SALT), which selects diverse anatomical centers and aggregates local features into localization tokens, and (iii) Localization-guided Cross Attention (LGCA), which uses these tokens as anatomically grounded queries.

The release contains the full training and inference code, the preprocessing pipeline (RAS reorientation, optional resampling, CT clipping to [-175, 250] HU, min-max normalization), the exact train/validation split files for BTCV13 (24/6) and for the ten Medical Segmentation Decathlon tasks (deterministic 80/20 split), the hyper-parameter and configuration files.

Trained model weights are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.

The datasets themselves are not redistributed: BTCV13 is available from Synapse (syn3193805) under the Synapse Terms and Conditions of Use and the Medical Segmentation Decathlon from medicaldecathlon.com under CC BY-SA 4.0.
